## Invitations

The North City 2025 Q2 outreach invited 6824 people. Attendance totalled 5340, representing a rate of 78.3 per cent. The results show that most invited people attended, although a proportion did not take part. The invitation process was supported by direct communication and local arrangements intended to make attendance possible where conditions allowed.

Van days were maintained where roads allowed. This provided an additional means of supporting access and helped maintain outreach activity across the area. Arrangements were adapted to local road conditions, with service delivery continuing when travel was practicable.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 5783 invitees. Reminders were also sent to 5783 people, providing a further prompt before the outreach activity. The matching figures indicate that reminders were issued across the same SMS contact group. Together, these communications supported the invitation process and reinforced attendance information.

Prepared by G. Evans.
